'''''XTB KSW 114: Parnasse vs. Held''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki]] on January 17, 2026, at the [[Radomskie Centrum Sportu|Radom Sports Center]] in [[Radom]], Poland.

===Background===
The event marked the promotion's fourth visit to Radom and first since [[2025_in_Konfrontacja_Sztuk_Walki#XTB_KSW_102:_Przybysz_vs._Azevedo|KSW 102]] in January 2025.<ref>{{Cite web|author=Waldemar Ossowski |date=12 November 2025 |title=Znamy szczegóły pierwszej gali KSW w 2026 roku. "Złoty" wróci do klatki |url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/1219387/znamy-szczegoly-pierwszej-gali-ksw-w-2026-roku-zloty-wroci-do-klatki |access-date=2025-12-17 |website=WP Sportowe Fakty |language=pl-PL}}</ref> 

The main event featured a [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Lightweight championship|KSW Lightweight Championship]] bout between current champion (also a current two-time [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Featherweight championship|KSW Featherweight Champion]]) [[Salahdine Parnasse]] and [[Marcin Held]].<ref>{{Cite web|author=Grzegorz Nielubiak |date=17 December 2025 |title=Salahdine Parnasse zmierzy się z Marcinem Heldem na gali XTB KSW 114 w Radomiu! |url=https://inthecage.pl/salahdine-parnasse-zmierzy-sie-z-marcinem-heldem-na-gali-xtb-ksw-114-w-radomiu/ |access-date=2025-12-17 |website=In The Cage |language=pl-PL}}</ref> The bout was originally scheduled to headline at [[2025 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 106: Parnasse vs. Ziółkowski|KSW 106]] in May 2025, but Held withdrew from the event due to a rib injury.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sobczak |first=Bartosz |date=2025-04-21 |title=Salahdine Parnasse vs Marian Ziółkowski na KSW 106 – do trzech razy sztuka |url=https://mymma.pl/salahdine-parnasse-vs-marian-ziolkowski-na-ksw-106-do-trzech-razy-sztuka/ |access-date=2026-04-08 |website=myMMA.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

Albert Odzimkowski was slated to make his promotional return on this event, but before his opponent was announced, he was forced to withdraw due to an injury.<ref>{{Cite web|author=Jacek Łosak |date=17 December 2025 |title=Albert Odzimkowski nie zawalczy na gali KSW w Radomiu |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw-114/albert-odzimkowski-nie-zawalczy-na-gali-ksw-w-radomiu |access-date=2025-12-17 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A light heavyweight bout between former [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Light heavyweight championship|KSW Light Heavyweight Champion]] [[Ibragim Chuzhigaev]] and [[Sergiusz Zając]] was scheduled for this event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zubkiewicz |first=Bartłomiej |date=2025-12-10 |title=Sergiusz Zając stanie przed największym wyzwaniem w karierze na KSW 114 {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ibragim-chuzhigaev/sergiusz-zajac-stanie-przed-najwiekszym-wyzwaniem-w-karierze-na-ksw-114 |access-date=2026-01-01 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, Zając withdrew from the bout due to health reasons and was replaced by Maciej Różański.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Łosak |first=Jacek |date=2026-01-01 |title=Zając wypada z gali XTB KSW 114. Chuzhigaev z nowym rywalem {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw-114/zajac-wypada-z-gali-xtb-ksw-114-chuzhigaev-z-nowym-rywalem |access-date=2026-01-01 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters were awarded bonuses:
* '''Performance of the Night: Salahdine Parnasse'''
* '''Knockout of the Night: Arkadiusz Wrzosek, Wiktoria Czyżewska''' and '''Andi Vrtačić'''

'''''XTB KSW 115: Przybysz vs. Yakymenko''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki]] on February 21, 2026, at the RCS Lubin in [[Lubin]], Poland.

===Background===
The event marked the promotion's third visit to Lubin and first since [[2024 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 98: Paczuski vs Zerhouni|KSW 98]] in September 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ossowski |first=Waldemar |date=2025-12-20 |title=KSW wraca do Lubina. Ogłoszono hitową walkę Polaków |url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/1225994/ksw-wraca-do-lubina-ogloszono-hitowa-walke-polakow |access-date=2025-12-21 |website=WP Sportowe Fakty |language=pl-PL}}</ref> 

A [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Bantamweight championship|KSW Bantamweight Championship]] bout between current two-time champion Sebastian Przybysz and [[Vitalii Yakymenko]] headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stachura |first=Bartłomiej |date=2025-12-20 |title=Sebastian Przybysz i Artur Szczepaniak wracają do akcji – dwie główne walki KSW 115 ogłoszone |url=https://www.lowking.pl/sebastian-przybysz-i-artur-szczepaniak-wracaja-do-akcji-dwie-glowne-walki-ksw-115-ogloszone/ |access-date=2025-12-21 |website=Lowking.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

[[Daniel Skibiński]] was originally scheduled to face [[Tymoteusz Łopaczyk]] in a welterweight bout at this event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-23 |title=Tymoteusz Łopaczyk zmierzy się z Danielem Skibińskim na KSW 115 |url=https://fightsport.pl/newsy/tymoteusz-lopaczyk-zmierzy-sie-z-danielem-skibinskim-na-ksw-115 |access-date=2026-01-24 |website=FightSport.PL |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, Łopaczyk withdrew from the fight due to a rib injury and was replaced by undefeated prospect [[Dawid Kuczmarski]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sobczak |first=Bartosz |date=2026-01-24 |title=Dawid Kuczmarski nowym rywalem Daniela Skibińskiego na KSW 115 w Lubinie |url=https://mymma.pl/dawid-kuczmarski-nowym-rywalem-daniela-skibinskiego-na-ksw-115-w-lubinie/ |access-date=2026-01-24 |website=myMMA.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

[[Dawid Kasperski]] and Jordan Nandor were scheduled to meet in a light heavyweight bout.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Droga do XTB KSW 115 – Dawid Kasperski i Jordan Nandor |url=https://www.kswmma.com/news/5926/droga-do-xtb-ksw-115-dawid-kasperski-i-jordan-nandor |access-date=2026-02-14 |website=Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, Kasperski had to withdraw from the bout due to a knee injury and was replaced by Kacper Sochacki.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Grzegorz |date=2026-02-13 |title=Jordan Nandor z nowym rywalem na galę XTB KSW 115 |url=https://inthecage.pl/jordan-nandor-z-nowym-rywalem-na-gale-xtb-ksw-115/ |access-date=2026-02-14 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

In addition, a middleweight bout between Borys Dzikowski and Adrian Dudek was also scheduled for this event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sobczak |first=Bartosz |date=2026-02-03 |title=Borys Dzikowski vs Adrian Dudek na KSW 115 w Lubinie |url=https://mymma.pl/borys-dzikowski-vs-adrian-dudek-na-ksw-115-w-lubinie/ |access-date=2026-02-14 |website=myMMA.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, Dudek withdrew due to an injury and was replaced by Kacper Pakeltys.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Grzegorz |date=2026-02-13 |title=Adrian Dudek wypada z XTB KSW 115! Kacper Pakeltys wskakuje na zastępstwo i zmierzy się z Borysem Dzikowskim |url=https://inthecage.pl/adrian-dudek-wypada-z-xtb-ksw-115-kacper-pakeltys-wskakuje-na-zastepstwo-i-zmierzy-sie-z-borysem-dzikowskim/ |access-date=2026-02-14 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters were awarded bonuses:
* '''Fight of the Night: Mariusz Joniak vs. Karol Durszlewicz'''
* '''Submission of the Night: Kristians Boguzs''' and '''Kacper Sochacki'''

===Background===
The event marked the promotion's second visit to Gdynia and first since [[2023 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 84: De Fries vs. Bajor|KSW 84]] in July 2023. This was celebration of the city's 100th anniversary.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tkaczuk |first=Michał |date=2026-04-15 |title=Ogłoszono termin, oraz miejsce gali XTB KSW 120. A [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Light Heavyweight Championship|KSW Light Heavyweight Championship]] rematch between current champion [[Rafał Haratyk]] and [[Bartosz Leśko]] headlined this event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Henning |first=Jakub |date=2026-05-13 |title=Wielki rewanż na KSW w Gdyni. Stawką ponownie będzie pas mistrzowski |url=https://mma.pl/wielki-rewanz-na-ksw-w-gdyni-stawka-ponownie-bedzie-pas-mistrzowski/ |access-date=2026-05-13 |website=MMA.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> The pairing previously met at [[2025 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 111: De Fries vs. Vojčák|KSW 111]] in October 2025, which Haratyk defended the title by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web|author=Michał Mielnik |date=18 October 2025 |title=25 minut to za mało, potrzebni byli sędziowie. Rafał Haratyk wciąż mistrzem KSW |url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/1215417/25-minut-to-za-malo-potrzebni-byli-sedziowie-rafal-haratyk-wciaz-mistrzem-ksw |access-date=2025-12-16 |website=WP Sportowe Fakty |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A featherweight bout between Oskar Stachura and Grzegorz Kowalski was scheduled at this event. However, Kowalski withdrew from his bout due to an injury and was replaced by Mateusz Balko.<ref>{{Cite web 
|title=Mateusz Balko nowym rywalem Oskara Stachury na galę XTB KSW 120 w Gdyni |url=https://www.kswmma.com/aktualnosci/mateusz-balko-nowym-rywalem-oskara-stachury-na-gale-xtb-ksw-120-w-gdyni |access-date=2026-06-15 |website=Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A bantamweight bout between former two-time [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Bantamweight Championship|KSW Bantamweight Champion]] Sebastian Przybysz and [[Rogério Bontorin]] was scheduled at this event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zubkiewicz |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-05-27 |title=Przybysz vs. Bontorin! Mocne starcie w kategorii koguciej na gali KSW w Gdyni {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ufc/przybysz-vs-bontorin-mocne-starcie-w-kategorii-koguciej-na-gali-ksw-w-gdyni |access-date=2026-02-18 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, Bontorin withdrew from the bout due to injury and was replaced by promotional newcomer Edgars Skrīvers.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zubkiewicz |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-06-29 |title=Sebastian Przybysz z nowym rywalem na galę KSW 120 w Gdyni {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/sebastian-przybysz-z-nowym-rywalem-na-gale-ksw-120-w-gdyni |access-date=2026-07-04 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

Laïd Zerhouni and Bartosz Kurek were scheduled to compete at the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zubkiewicz |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-06-08 |title=Laïd Zerhouni zmierzy się z niepokonanym Bartoszem Kurkiem na gali XTB KSW 120 {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/laid-zerhouni/laid-zerhouni-zmierzy-sie-z-niepokonanym-bartoszem-kurkiem-na-gali-xtb-ksw-120 |access-date=2026-07-19 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, the bout was cancelled in late minute after Zerhouni withdrew due to health issues.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Staff |date=2026-07-18 |title=KSW 120: Haratyk vs. Lesko 2 Full Results |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2026/07/18/ksw-120-haratyk-vs-lesko-2-full-results/ |access-date=2026-07-19 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref>

'''''XTB KSW 122: Yakymenko vs. Morelli''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki]] on October 10, 2026, at [[Hala Podpromie]] in [[Rzeszów]], Poland.

===Background===
The event marked the promotion's second visit to Rzeszów and first since [[2025 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 110: Grzebyk vs. Tulshaev|KSW 110]] in September 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Celuth |first=Martyna |date=2026-07-18 |title=Mistrzowskie starcie Bartosińskiego z Masaevem walką wieczoru gali KSW |url=https://inthecage.pl/mistrzowskie-starcie-bartosinskiego-z-masaevem-walka-wieczoru-gali-ksw-122/ |access-date=2026-07-19 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Welterweight championship|KSW Welterweight Championship]] bout between current champion [[Adrian Bartosiński]] and undefeated prospect Adam Masaev was originally scheduled to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Łosak |first=Jacek |date=2026-07-18 |title=Bartosiński vs Masaev walką wieczoru gali XTB KSW 122 {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/bartosinski-vs-masaev-walka-wieczoru-gali-xtb-ksw-122 |access-date=2026-07-19 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, Masaev withdrew from the bout due to a hand injury and Bartosiński was then rebooked one month later at [[#XTB KSW 123: Bartosiński vs. Łopaczyk|KSW 123]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stachura |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-09-03 |title=Adam Masaev wypadł z walki z Adrianem Bartosińskim na KSW 122 – nowym rywalem mistrza na KSW 123 Tymoteusz Łopaczyk |url=https://www.lowking.pl/adam-masaev-wypadl-z-walki-z-adrianem-bartosinskim-na-ksw-122-nowym-rywalem-mistrza-na-ksw-123-tymoteusz-lopaczyk/ |access-date=2026-09-04 |website=Lowking.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A [[KSW Bantamweight Championship]] bout between current champion [[Vitalii Yakymenko]] and Marcelo Morelli was scheduled to take place at co-main event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Gregorz |date=2026-06-08 |title=Yakymenko vs. Morelli! Drugie starcie o pas na gali XTB KSW 122 |url=https://inthecage.pl/yakymenko-vs-morelli-drugie-starcie-o-pas-na-gali-xtb-ksw-122/ |access-date=2026-08-24 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> After the original headliner was cancelled, the bout was promoted to new main event status.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Łosak |first=Jacek |date=2026-09-03 |title=Duże zmiany i wielkie walki na XTB KSW 122 oraz XTB KSW 123 {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/duze-zmiany-i-wielkie-walki-na-xtb-ksw-122-oraz-xtb-ksw-123 |access-date=2026-09-04 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A bantamweight bout between Andrzej Karkula and Sebastian Decowski was scheduled at this event, but Decowski withdrew due to an injury and was replaced by Kamil Korzeniowski.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Gregorz |date=2026-09-22 |title=Andrzej Karkula z nowym rywalem na galę XTB KSW 122 |url=https://inthecage.pl/andrzej-karkula-z-nowym-rywalem-na-gale-xtb-ksw-122/ |access-date=2026-09-23 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A light heavyweight bout between [[Sergiusz Zając]] and Bartosz Szewczyk was scheduled at the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zubkiewicz |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-08-20 |title=Starcie czołowych półciężkich dodane do karty walk gali XTB KSW 122 {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/bartosz-szewczyk/starcie-czolowych-polciezkich-dodane-do-karty-walk-gali-xtb-ksw-122 |access-date=2026-09-04 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref> However, Szewczyk withdrew from the bout due to an injury and was replaced by Salim El Ouassaidi.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Gregorz |date=2026-09-29 |title=Sergiusz Zając z nowym rywalem na galę XTB KSW 122 |url=https://inthecage.pl/sergiusz-zajac-z-nowym-rywalem-na-gale-xtb-ksw-122/ |access-date=2026-10-05 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

The fighters were fined a percentage of their individual purses which went to their opponents Andrzej Grzebyk (40 percent), Mateusz Makarowski (30 percent) and El Ouassaidi (50 percent) respectively, also received a one-point deduction at the start of the fight.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stachura |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-10-09 |title=Kabaret w Rzeszowie! The event will mark the promotion's fifth visit to Szczecin and first since [[2025 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 112: Kaczmarczyk vs. Soldaev|KSW 112]] in November 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-09-03 |title=Adrian Bartosiński vs Tymoteusz Łopaczyk o pas na KSW 123 w Szczecinie! |url=https://fightsport.pl/newsy/adrian-bartosinski-vs-tymoteusz-lopaczyk-o-pas-na-ksw-123-w-szczecinie |access-date=2026-09-04 |website=FightSport.PL |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

Bartosiński podejmie Łopaczyka na gali XTB KSW 123 |url=https://inthecage.pl/masaev-znowu-kontuzjowany-bartosinski-podejmie-lopaczyka-na-gali-xtb-ksw-123/ |access-date=2026-09-04 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A [[KSW Lightweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between former interim champion [[Valeriu Mircea]] and [[Marcin Held]] is scheduled to serve as the co-main event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Gregorz |date=2026-09-05 |title=Mircea vs Held!
